entities.name: Chūhachi Ninomiya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chūhachi Ninomiya  was a Japanese aviation pioneer. He is remembered for his unique aircraft designs - the "Karasu-gata mokei hikouki" and the "Tamamushi-gata hikouki". He designed a flying machine with three engines earlier than the Wright brothers, it contributed to Japan's accumulation of capabilities to design and manufacture aircraft by the 1930s.

He designed a flying machine with three engines earlier than the Wright brothers, it contributed to Japan's accumulation of capabilities to design and manufacture aircraft by the 1930s.
